event.title: Ed Sheeran's Tour Faces Disruption as Opening Acts Withdraw in Support of Macklemore
event.canonical_title: Ed Sheeran's Tour Faces Disruption as Opening Acts Withdraw in Support of Macklemore
event.summary: All four supporting acts for Ed Sheeran's US tour have withdrawn in solidarity with rapper Macklemore, who was dropped from the tour after making comments in support of Palestine. The artists who exited include Irish acts Aaron Rowe and Beoga, Danish band Lukas Graham, and American singer Finneas. They announced their decision on social media, highlighting their support for Macklemore amidst the controversy surrounding his remarks about Gaza.

timeline.title: Ed Sheeran's Tour Faces Disruption as Opening Acts Withdraw in Support of Macklemore
timeline.summary: Ed Sheeran's tour across North and South America is facing significant challenges after four opening acts withdrew in solidarity with rapper Macklemore. This decision follows Macklemore's removal from the tour due to his pro-Palestinian comments made during a performance.
